root_cause_research.confirmed_mechanism: Same-user worker exit transition makes KERN_PROCARGS2 return EINVAL; psutil 7.2.2 can map this to PermissionError/AccessDenied before zombie classification catches up. Current production matching can still raise during that transition; watch does not catch it.
root_cause_research.historic_limit: Original worker PID 56064 stderr has the same real error path after OCR failure, but no simultaneous process-state trace. Exact kernel branch for that historical PID cannot be reconstructed.
root_cause_research.measurement_limit: Tight sampling intentionally targets exit; 200/200 is not an operational incident rate. Summary inexit_observed omits between; corrected counts inspect before/between/after. proc_pidinfo may return ESRCH for both exiting and zombie children, so ESRCH alone is not treated as proof of fully gone.
